text: DSH Schema Migration Proof 是面向 DSH 的迁移证据核验插件，通过两个工具检查固定迁移证据清单。它可检查重复运行是否幂等、可逆迁移是否回滚成功、必需不变量是否通过，以及有损字段是否披露；验证工具还会写出内容寻址的报告。适合需要审阅 schema 迁移测试证据的开发者。使用文件式 DSH 工具需要本地 Node.js；未发现运行时所需的 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Schema Migration Proof checks migration evidence for idempotence, rollback, invariants, and disclosed data loss. Verification writes a content-addressed report for developers reviewing schema migration tests. File-based use needs Node.js; no runtime key or external service is identified.
我想确认一份 schema 迁移测试重复执行后结果一致。
怎么检查数据库结构迁移的回滚和必需不变量是否通过？
I need a report showing whether a schema migration test disclosed every lossy field.
DSH Schema Migration Proof 的功能「迁移证据核验」：对给定迁移清单检查幂等性、可逆迁移的回滚结果、必需不变量状态和有损字段披露。通过 DSH 的核验工具传入迁移文件与报告目录，输出核验状态、发现项和内容寻址报告。
dsh-schema-migration-proof 提供工具 dsh_schema_migration_inspect：Inspect one revision-bound migration evidence manifest without returning data bodies.
dsh-schema-migration-proof 提供工具 dsh_schema_migration_verify：Verify idempotence, rollback, required invariants and loss disclosure; write one content-addressed report.

dsh-schema-migration-proof README · DSH Schema Migration Proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, content-addressed evidence for recorded DeepSeek Harness schema migrations. It verifies fixed fixture envelopes for output determinism, idempotent reruns, reversible rollback, required invariants and explicit lossy-field disclosure without executing a migration or returning data bodies.

dsh-schema-migration-proof README · DSH Schema Migration Proof：This is not a migration runner, database tool, recovery system, or second surface-contract verifier. `dsh-recovery-proof` tests isolated restore drills; `dsh-surface-contract-proof` compares ToolRuntime/MCP/CLI envelopes; `dsh-lineage` records object/action relationships. This project scores the evidence produced by a migration test harness whose tool revision and source/target schemas are pinned.

dsh-schema-migration-proof README · DSH Schema Migration Proof：The manifest contains only stable IDs and SHA-256 digests. Body-, data-, payload-, secret-, credential-, prompt- and message-shaped fields are rejected. A required invariant that is missing, failed or unobserved fails closed. A reversible migration must prove rollback, and a lossy fixture must enumerate every disclosed loss field.

dsh-schema-migration-proof README · Surfaces：- DSH: `dsh_schema_migration_inspect`, `dsh_schema_migration_verify`.
- CLI: `dsh-schema-migration-proof verify --workspace-root examples --migration migration.json --artifact-dir artifacts`.
- MCP: `schema_migration_inspect_inline`, `schema_migration_verify_inline`; bounded inline JSON only, no filesystem, network, child process or migration execution.

dsh-schema-migration-proof README · DSH Schema Migration Proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

对 DeepSeek Harness schema 迁移的离线内容寻址证据层。它只核验固定 fixture envelope：输出确定性、重复执行幂等、可逆回滚、必需不变量以及有损字段披露；绝不执行迁移、连接数据库或返回数据正文。

它不是迁移运行器，也不复制恢复演练、跨表面契约或血缘账本。`dsh-recovery-proof` 验证隔离恢复，`dsh-surface-contract-proof` 比较 ToolRuntime/MCP/CLI envelope，`dsh-lineage` 记录对象关系；本插件只给固定工具 revision 与 source/target schema 的迁移测试证据判分。

dsh-schema-migration-proof README · DSH Schema Migration Proof：manifest 仅含稳定 ID 与 SHA-256。正文、data、payload、秘密、凭据、prompt、message 形字段会被拒绝；必需不变量缺失、失败或未观察都会失败闭合。DSH/CLI 只读 workspace 内显式文件并向 `artifactDir` 写回读验证产物；MCP 只处理有界内联 JSON。
